label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
**Subject: I'm safe, and an update from Thandi**

Hi everyone,

I'm writing this once so I don't have to keep answering the same messages one by one. I'm sorry if you've been waiting on a reply. My phone has been going nonstop since Saturday, and I'm running on very little sleep.

First, the most important part: I'm safe. I'm okay, or getting there. I'm staying with my sister for now, and I'm not in any physical danger. Please don't worry about me being hurt.

On Saturday night, 7 November, a fire started in a ground-floor flat at Lindale Court in Obs. I live on the second floor. Everyone in the building got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home. The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess about it.

I woke up because our neighbour, Uncle Faizel, went door to door on our floor in his vest and slippers, banging on every door until everyone was awake. I grabbed my phone and my cat, Marmalade, and nothing else. Marmalade hid under a car for two hours afterwards, which I'm told is normal for cats, and which I'm choosing to find very funny now.

My flat is badly damaged. There's smoke and water everywhere, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says no one can go back in for at least six weeks. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't, and she's fine, so I'm counting that as a win.

The thing I'm most sad about is that I had all my end-of-year concert materials at home to laminate. That means the 22 crowns and the kids' handprint banner are gone. So if you're one of the Ladybirds' parents: the concert on 27 November is still happening, and yes, the Ladybirds will still have crowns. I'll figure something out.

**What I need**

I hate asking for help, so I'm going to be specific so it's easy to know how to help.

- **Help with a deposit for a new place.** This is the biggest thing. Finding somewhere to live quickly takes money upfront that I didn't plan for.
- **School shoes and work clothes**, size 6 shoes and size 34 for clothing.
- **A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works.** All my lesson planning was on mine, so this would really help me get back into my classroom routine.

**What I don't need**

Please don't send more clothes in general. I've been given so many clothes that I have more than I can use. I'm going to pass the extras to the other families in the building who lost things too. Please also don't bring food. My sister's freezer is full, and I'm honestly embarrassed by how much she's been cooking.

**The fundraiser**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me, and I'm still a bit uncomfortable with it, but she told me to stop arguing and accept it. It's here:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, and it was at R11 400 this morning. Every rand helps, and if you can share the link, that helps too.

**Please be careful about a fake fund**

Some people have sent me messages about a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on another site, and a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **That is not me, and I have not set up any other fund.** I've reported it. If you're asked to donate anywhere other than the BackaBuddy link above, please don't. If you've already sent money to the fake account, please contact your bank right away and report it.

If you want to pass this letter on, please do. Just make sure the fundraiser link is the one you pass on, and warn people about the fake one too.

**Back at school**

I'm going back to Little Acorns on Wednesday. Please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They're four and five, and they don't need to know anything beyond the fact that Miss Thandi had a fire at home and is okay. If they want to give me a hug, that's great. I'll take a hug from any Ladybird.

**Replies**

I'm really grateful, and I can't put into words how much it means that so many of you have reached out. I've been crying at almost every message, so please bear with me. I'm going to reply slowly, so if I don't answer your DM, please don't be offended. I see every message, and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

To the mom who dropped a bag of clothes at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking: thank you. That bag meant more than you probably know.

With love and a lot of gratitude,

Thandi

reasons: It does not explicitly say that replies to comments will be slow.
